semantic_scope: Approved catalog unit meanings retained. Fresh full provider translations must be recorded literally and are not automatically semantically approved.
separate_negative_scenarios: No models: approved automatic partial does not query readiness or translator; explicit full returns model-not-ready while keeping partial.
Translator error/timeout: explicit full keeps identical approved source slots and exposes retry.
Two simultaneous explicit requests for same request identity share at most one provider task.
Identity/generation/input-language changes: late extension cannot update the new message; approved previous slots are not transferred.
Cancel or return to immersed/original: stop/cancel pending intent where possible; if provider cannot cancel, discard stale output.
Zero spans or failed source anchoring cannot qualify automatic sufficiency.
